items.title: Multiple Vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This bulletin addresses 11 vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) flaw (CVE-2026-103849, CVSS 10.0) and an incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce B2B (CVE-2026-92909, CVSS 9.8) allowing unauthenticated code execution.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This emergency hotfix resolves a critical template engine injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650, CVSS 10.0) that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code. Adobe is aware of active exploitation of this vulnerability in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses eight vulnerabilities, including two high-severity stored cross-site scripting (XSS) flaws (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201, CVSS 9.3) and several incorrect authorization issues that could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin resolves seven vulnerabilities, including a critical unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw (CVE-2026-71362, CVSS 9.1) that could lead to customer account takeover and privilege escalation. Indications of exploitation in the wild have emerged.
